title: Smart Data Models - Gaia-X Ontology - LabelCredential
description: https://w3id.org/gaia-x/2.1.11#class/LabelCredential. Gaia-X compliance engine issued credential representing a Gaia-X conformity label level.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'LabelCredential'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

labelLevel.description: Property. Abbreviated conformity level of the label credential (SC, L1, L2, ...). Controlled-vocabulary value (LabelLevel), enumeration not resolved in this pass.

engineVersion.description: Property. Gaia-X compliance engine version that delivered the label credential.

rulesVersion.description: Property. Gaia-X compliance document version from which the validated criteria originate.

validatedCriteria.description: Property. Gaia-X compliance criteria validated for this label credential.

compliantCredentials.description: Relationship. Credentials validated by the compliance engine and linked to this label credential. Links to one or more CompliantCredential entities.
